prompt:
Generate LEGACY-01 / Extended City Asset Family, a STATIC art master sheet for Civilization Town / Living Settlement. This covers the twelve older callable BuildingFactory assets that remain outside the active ancient catalog. Do not add them to the playable catalog or change gameplay. Keep the same illustrated pixel-art craftsmanship, isometric camera, material treatment and silhouette clarity as WORLD-01 and BLDG-01 while depicting the later city-era contents of these existing IDs.

PLATFORM: Desktop asset-library review.

PAGE STRUCTURE:
1. Small heading "LEGACY-01 / Extended City Family" and a clear "Inactive catalog - static concepts only" label.
2. One large original downloadable illustration containing exactly twelve separated full objects in a 3-row x 4-column matrix, generous empty padding around each:
 Row 1: road (asphalt junction with sidewalk), streetlight (complete lamp post and base), small_house (compact single-family cottage), family_house (larger two-story family home).
 Row 2: apartment (modest apartment building), shop (small storefront with awning), bakery (bakery storefront with bread display), restaurant (restaurant with seating terrace).
 Row 3: school (small school building and entrance), clinic (neighborhood medical clinic), park (garden with benches and paths), tree (a complete shade tree with trunk and roots).
3. A smaller scale/reference strip compares cottage, family home, apartment and a neutral CHAR-01 person beside a standard doorway. Keep structures grounded and their entrances readable.
4. Concise ID list with source ownership "BuildingFactory legacy paths" and export status. Do not invent new IDs, costs, era unlocks or active placement rules.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Render actual original asset imagery, not CSS building blocks, font icons, emoji, stock photography or a map screenshot.
- Every structure must be fully visible including roof and foundation, with no overlap between cells. Avoid text/signage baked over the asset pixels; place IDs outside their extraction area.
- These are static design masters. No animations, characters moving, traffic, blinking streetlights, GIFs, smoke effects or time-of-day demo.
- Reuse the project's existing Living Settlement design system. Do not create an unrelated modern dashboard interface.

screens.title:
Authentic 16-bit retro isometric strategy game pixel-art building sprite master sheet: "LEGACY-01 Extended City Family (3x4 Matrix)" on a solid, completely flat, uniform parchment beige background (#E7DABC) with generous empty space separating every single structure for clean sprite slicing and isolation. Consistent isometric projection (true 2:1 dimetric angle, upper-right sunlight illumination, sharp pixel clusters, dark plum outline #302C36, restrained 2-3 shade steps from the Living Settlement 28-color palette: #59845A, #527B8C, #65483C, #AD644D, #C2A05B, #919B8B, #B28E65, #E8BA55). Strictly no text, labels or numbers baked into the sprite pixels. Completely static, unpopulated masters.

Exactly 12 distinct isolated full objects in an exact 3 rows by 4 columns matrix:

Row 1:
1. road: Modular paved town road junction with curb stone sidewalk and subtle cobblestone/asphalt texture.
2. streetlight: Complete ornate cast-iron Victorian/craftsman street lamp post with sturdy grounded plinth base and glass lantern top.
3. small_house: Compact single-story suburban cottage home with brick chimney, tiled gabled roof, framed windows and clean front door.
4. family_house: Larger two-story family home with multi-pitch tiled roof, bay windows, timber-clad porch and dormer.

Row 2:
5. apartment: Modest multi-story brick/stone town apartment block with repeated sash windows, cornice roofline and grounded entrance stoop.
6. shop: Cozy merchant storefront with pitched striped fabric awning, display window bay and wooden front door.
7. bakery: Warm artisan bakery storefront with display vitrine showing baked bread loaves, striped canvas canopy, wooden signboard bracket.
8. restaurant: Charming neighborhood restaurant with cozy ground-floor dining entrance and outdoor pergola/terrace railing with tiny bistro tables.

Row 3:
9. school: Classic municipal brick school building with small entrance bell tower / clock cupola, dual entrance steps and wide scholastic windows.
10. clinic: Orderly town medical clinic / apothecary with clean pale masonry walls, tiled hipped roof, clean entry portico with subtle medical caduceus/cross relief on lintel.
11. park: Municipal pocket garden park tile with low stone perimeter edging, compact gravel pathway, manicured flower bed, and wooden park bench.
12. tree: Complete mature town shade tree with broad lush foliage crown (#59845A), visible sturdy bark trunk and grounded root flare.

All 12 assets are completely isolated with wide margins, fully intact foundations and roofs, zero overlap, crisp retro pixel art craftsmanship matching Civilization Town / Living Settlement aesthetic. Uniform flat #E7DABC background throughout.
